issue_context.title: Add cache mechanism to line count estimation to reduce backend load

review_comments: Is it possible to run Start in init()?

```init()``` is a bad code style.

refer https://github.com/uber-go/guide/blob/master/style.md#avoid-init
Looks like many "func init()" need to be revisited.
```GetApproximateTableCountFromStorage``` is the same as the old. but we add cache here.
I think we don't call `Start()` in tests. Is it safe to use it without calling `Start()`?
Because it is globally unique, it started when it start up. ```Start``` is to start the eviction goroutine. It does not affect normal use.
I suggest add some comments since we are introducing the "backend components" new concept to this package.
